body.statement: Under a supplied tree decomposition of width \(w\) for the intervened target ground graph and fixed finite alphabets, can the proof-carrying compilation handle produce the correct dense \(F\), all target-relevant context-incidence counts, and a locally checkable derivation in time and certificate length polynomial in the explicit grounding size and exponential only in \(w\), so that composition with \(Check\) certifies the sharp interval end to end?
body.justification: The fixed checker consumes explicit assignment-level incidence and factorization records; a width-sensitive producer would remove that representation boundary without making a false unrestricted polynomial-time claim.
body.gap: Hutschenreiter, Baier, and Klein give polynomial univariate model checking after explicit-state construction, while no identified paper controls compilation from a succinct relational grounding with context sharing.
body.consumer: Bounded-treewidth traffic and object-interaction scenes could receive a single end-to-end certificate rather than an externally promised polynomial.
